description: What we would pay for a given weight of gold, silver or platinum at today's published rate. purity accepts carats (9, 14, 18, 22, 24, '18ct', '18k'), hallmark numbers (375, 585, 750, 916, 999, 925, 958, 800) or words (sterling, fine, bullion). Weight is grams of the item as it sits on the scale. Returns the rate per gram, the total and the spot quote time; the final figure follows weighing and XRF testing.

purity.description: Carat, hallmark fineness number or grade word, e.g. 9, '18ct', 750, 'sterling'

weight_grams.description: Weight of the item in grams (0 to 100000)

title: Estimate what we would pay
